material_claims.statement: No repository-recognized unconditional proof covering every even integer greater than 2 is recorded; binary Goldbach remains open in this baseline.
cannot_imply: A search failure alone cannot prove openness; new resolution claims require separate audit.

material_claims.statement: The inherited literature record reports bounded verification for all even integers through 4*10^18.
cannot_imply: Cannot exclude counterexamples above the verified bound.

material_claims.statement: Every odd integer greater than 5 is a sum of three primes.
cannot_imply: Does not prove the two-prime statement.

material_claims.statement: Every sufficiently large even integer is a prime plus an integer with at most two prime factors.
cannot_imply: P2 need not be prime.

material_claims.statement: An explicit Chen-type result holds above exp(exp(32.7)).
cannot_imply: Does not prove p+p or provide a practical small threshold.

material_claims.statement: Zhao v2 claims E(X)=O(X^(7/10)) with ineffective implicit constant.
